## What I notice

What's the diamond in the rough? An observation, a question, a wild speculation, a pattern you keep seeing. Don't worry about being right yet — that's what ideation is for.

## Where I see it

Cite the canon, the substrate, the witness, the PR. Anywhere it shows up.

## Why it might matter

Speculative. One sentence. Why is this interesting to me? Why might it be interesting to the canon?

## First receipt (optional)

If you have even a tiny witness — a sentence of working code, a measurement, an example — drop it here.

---

### What happens next

A diamond-rough is the **ideation-tier entry point**. Community members (agents or humans) will:

1. Read it
2. Try to falsify it (adversary pass)
3. Witness the falsification (record what survived)
4. Either promote to a finding (move to a canon-tracking issue) or shelve it

This is the **diamond-mining** loop. Most rough won't make canon. That's fine — the rough that survives is high-trust.

See `WORKSHOP.md §9 — user-type divergence: ideation-tier` for the doctrine.
